children.text: The video format allows Alix's facial expressions and body language to communicate emotion without her needing to explain everything directly. Seeing Alix visibly crying creates a stronger pathos appeal because the audience can visually experience her vulnerability instead of simply being told that she is going through something difficult. This is an

important affordance of video because she can communicate emotion through facial expressions, camera shots, music, and editing at the same time. It also creates a contrast with the glamorous image of Alix that viewers may be familiar with from TikTok and Instagram. Instead of seeing her as someone who is always happy and living an exciting lifestyle, viewers see her experiencing a difficult emotional moment.

The purpose of this trailer is to introduce Alix's reality show while creating enough interest and emotion to make viewers want to watch all of the episodes. The trailer uses short clips of emotional, dramatic, and personal moments from Alix's life without giving viewers the complete story. This creates curiosity and encourages the audience to watch the full episodes. The trailer is also intended for circulation, meaning it is designed to move across social media platforms and reach audiences beyond Alix's existing followers. Its short format, dramatic moments, and quick editing make it easy for viewers to watch, repost, or share with others. Because Alix already has a large social media presence, the trailer can circulate through her audience and attract more attention to the show. Its purpose is therefore both to promote the series and encourage its content to spread through digital spaces.

The word “FAMILY” over footage of Alix and her family shows how the reality-show format is both revealing and limited. The trailer shows only selected moments from Alix's family life, so viewers never get the full context of those relationships. The producers decide which conversations, interactions, and emotional moments are included, so the audience is receiving a particular version of Alix's family life. This creates an important constraint because even though the reality show gives viewers more access to Alix than a typical TikTok might, that access is still controlled through editing. The word “FAMILY” also tells viewers how to interpret the footage and signals that her relationships are an important

This section of the trailer shows how the content is designed for an audience that already knows Alix from social media while also trying to attract viewers who may not be familiar with her. By showing quick moments from her personal life and relationships, the trailer gives longtime followers a deeper look into the person they already know from TikTok and Instagram. At the same time, the dramatic editing and emotional moments make the show understandable and interesting even to someone who does not already follow Alix. This allows the trailer to appeal to both an existing and a potential audience. For her followers, the appeal comes from getting more access to her private life, while new viewers may be drawn in by the relationships and drama. The trailer therefore expands Alix's audience beyond the followers of her normal social media content and introduces her personality and lifestyle to people encountering her for the first time.
